model_comparison.note: the model values are FPG-based estimates, not like-for-like arm-F measurements

memory_method: peak_mb: sampled peak of the summed physical footprint of the compile's process tree (dfthc.testing.watchdog), the gate metric; the watchdog kills the tree above the limit. rusage_sum_mb: the getrusage companion, ru_maxrss of the compile process plus ru_maxrss of its finished children. It is not an upper bound: under memory pressure the resident size drops compressed pages that the footprint keeps counting, so it can fall below peak_mb
